name: angels_space_age_galore
title: Angel's+Space Age Galore
author: JTnadrooi
description: An overhaul mod that seamlessly integrates all 4 Angel's mods (and optionally all Angel's Addons) with Space Age! It builds on the pure-Angel's framework established in Angel's Galore. Includes all 3 Galore mods. No factory will be the same.
